message.content: In the conversation, Li Hua expresses a positive sentiment towards the Blood and Wine expansion, stating that it is "incredible." She highlights the stunning new area of Toussaint and compliments the storytelling, describing it as a "mini-epic." This indicates that Li Hua found the expansion to be visually appealing and well-crafted, making it a standout addition to the game. Additionally, she notes that the story feels like it has its own distinct narrative, suggesting that it successfully offers a unique experience within the larger Witcher 3 universe.
